title: Bitnami public catalog distribution/support change: versioned images moved to bitnamilegacy, mainline limited to latest-only community tier
summary: Effective 2025-08-28 (deletion postponed to 2025-09-29 after feedback), docker.io/bitnami stops publishing versioned Debian-based images/charts in OCI format. Existing versioned tags (e.g. 2.50.0, 10.6) moved to docker.io/bitnamilegacy with no further updates/support (temporary migration aid). Mainline keeps only a limited hardened subset as latest-only for dev via bitnamisecure. Production requires Bitnami Secure Images subscription. Source code stays Apache-2.0 on GitHub. Brownouts: 2025-08-28, 2025-09-02, 2025-09-17. Anyone pinning docker.io/bitnami:<version> or Helm values referencing X.Y.Z-debian-12-rX is affected.

evidences.excerpt: As of August 28th, 2025, the Bitnami public catalog will undergo changes: disable Debian-based image generation, move existing versioned tags to Bitnami Legacy repository (docker.io/bitnamilegacy) with no further updates or support; free images limited to latest tag via bitnamisecure; Helm/container source stays Apache-2.0 on GitHub. Deletion postponed to September 29th with brownouts Aug 28, Sep 2, Sep 17.

Upcoming changes to the Bitnami catalog (effective August 28th, 2025): since Aug 28 no new Bitnami container images or Helm charts published to Docker Hub in OCI format; legacy assets archived in Bitnami Legacy repository; public catalog switches to limited community-tier latest-only subset.

Starting August 28th, Bitnami archives its OCI registry to Bitnami Legacy; users must update pipelines/mirrors/clusters. Options: switch to Bitnami Secure Images (recommended, full version support) or Bitnami Legacy (unsupported snapshot, temporary, copy images to own registry).
